process_mcp_request: process an MCP request by extracting and validating authentication headers from an ASGI scope
get_allowed_mcp_servers: get the list of MCP servers allowed for a user based on key, team, and end-user permissions
get_allowed_tools_for_server: get the list of allowed tool names for a specific MCP server based on key and team permissions
is_tool_allowed_for_server: check if a specific tool is allowed for a given MCP server based on user permissions
get_mcp_access_groups: get the list of MCP access groups for a user based on key and team permissions
